acquisition_channels.details: The family says celebrity photos displayed at the shop and appearances in films brought visitors.
The guest says customers who left Philadelphia talked about Pat's and returned when visiting.
Goldbelly handled shipped cheesesteak orders, especially during COVID.
The Italian Market location and nearby film/tourist interest brought walk-in customers.
